_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Yïn ee Yicök {player_id} Tic Tac Toe.
Yïn ee wäŋ yäŋ yäŋ kekäŋ (wäŋ nhöl, wäŋ käŋ, wäŋ käŋ nhöl) kekäŋ.
Yïn ee käŋ yäŋ yäŋ, yïn ee yäŋ yäŋ kekäŋ (0-8) yïn ee yäŋ yäŋ yäŋ.
Alɔŋ, '[4]' ee yäŋ yäŋ yäŋ kekäŋ kekäŋ.
Yïn ee Yicök {player_id}, yïn ee '{symbol}', wä yïn ee yäŋ yäŋ '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɛn duɔ̱ɔ̱p in ca la̱th thi̱n /cɛ tä kɛ thurɛ mi gɔaa.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} /ciɛ jɛn thɛl mi̱ lot rɔ. Jɛn bɛ yiɛn kam 0 kɛnɛ 8.

game_action.placed: Riɛl {player_id} acë thëm ë mäth ({symbol}) ë gɛ̈l {cell}.

outcome.draw: Ɛn duel ɛ mi̱ caa kuɛn!
